title: Realistic Graphics via Voxel Cone Tracing
content: Creating photo-real graphics in real time on a normal computer is difficult because it requires calculating light transport, or the infinite potential pathways of light rays that interact with the subject at hand.By using a technique calledvoxelcone tracing, a remarkable level of naturalism is possible within fast computational times, which makes it applicable to video game graphics.--Watch the YouTube video by Two Minute Papers
